== Title ==
<span lang="ja">はぐれバンサ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2名までの乗客を追加できる。バンサは能力値＝1/2。“リアクション”として移動できる。屋外の位置カードで戦闘が行われたら、開始時に同じ場所にいるタスケン・レイダーを一名（どれにするかはこちらが選べる）“踏んづける”（即座にロストする）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダーの若者の扱いのまずさから、荒野に逃げ出してしまったバンサ。モイスチャー・ファーマーが手なずけたため、よそ者にもよくなつくが、タスケン・レイダーだけは見たとたんに攻撃し始める。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rogue Bantha]].

'''Lore''' — A bantha that fled into the wilderness after a young Tusken Raider handled it poorly. A moisture farmer tamed it, so it is friendly to strangers, but it attacks Tusken Raiders on sight.

'''Game text''' — May add up to 2 passengers. Bantha ability equals 1/2. May move as a react. When a battle is fought at an exterior location card, at the start one Tusken Raider at the same place (your choice) is trampled (immediately lost).

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese lore says a moisture farmer tamed it (手なずけた); English says it was raised by a moisture farmer. Exterior site is 屋外の位置カード. Trample prints “踏んづける”.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-roguebantha-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rogue Bantha]].</ref>
